shortDescription: Adds or removes tags to/from assets.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies whether to add or remove tags.

options.name: assets
options.description: An array of asset UUIDs to which the tags should be added or from which tags should be removed. For more information on determining values for this array https://developer.tenable.com/docs/determine-tag-identifiers-tio

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of tag value UUIDs to be assigned or removed. For more information on determining values for this array https://developer.tenable.com/docs/determine-tag-identifiers-tio
